case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You described a cost environment of alloy and material pressure, and Option A below answers it with a longer contract term and a firm price for the supplier to plan on.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own purchase history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. It is short enough to approve as it stands.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We acknowledge the index movements you cited; however, our alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning these reductions do not currently reach our costs. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, so we have introduced an AS-14404 index clause to make this extended duration possible. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your Option C, we propose €5.32 per unit with 45 days payment and a 24-month contract. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.32 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You asked for an index clause to cover alloy and material costs. None of our options contains one. Option A instead gives you a firm price and a longer contract term to plan on, so you carry no index risk over that period.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.02; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.98; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal the longest contract term and the most predictable business, and it addresses the delivery record above.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As your pricing committee will need to decide, please take Option A to the person who approves prices on your side. It is a single, clear proposal: a firm unit price and a contract term that lets you plan. If the committee needs anything further from us to approve it, we will provide it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.27 per unit with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

It is always a pleasure to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we value our ongoing relationship very much. We have reviewed your request with our management and can accommodate the 90-day payment term you strongly prefer. However, a fixed price over a 24-month period remains unfeasible, making the AS-14404 index clause a strict requirement. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary offer stands at a price of €4.99 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 90 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.16 per unit. For this alternative, it features a price of €5.16 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
